_comment: Fixtures for the Finishers tab. themeTestDecks.json is useless here — those decks were built to probe THEME detection, so they carry theme-identifying cards and almost no win conditions, and every one of them scored 'no way to close'. Each deck below is a deliberate, unambiguous example of ONE finisher shape, with `expect` naming the shape that should lead. Kept small (~35 cards) on purpose: these exercise the kill math, not deckbuilding. Land counts are real so the mana ceiling and land-ratio math get honest inputs.

decks.name: Craterhoof — alpha strike
decks.note: Wide board plus a trampling overrun. Should cap at 1/opponents — that ceiling is the headline claim of the whole model.

decks.name: Exsanguinate — X drain
decks.note: Hits every opponent, so it has no single-target cap and should outrank Craterhoof despite far less raw damage. The X-cost parse (single X, fixed BB) is the thing under test.

decks.name: Gray Merchant — devotion drain
decks.note: The curated SCALING_MAP path. Heavy double-black pips on purpose so devotion is large — and the board-fraction discount should stop it reading as a whole-deck count.

decks.name: Thoracle — alt win, ENABLED
decks.note: Oracle plus real library-emptying (Consultation, Tainted Pact, mill). Should score as a live win — and the Spellbook index should also see the combo outright.

decks.name: Thoracle — alt win, NO SUPPORT
decks.note: The overclaim canary. A lone Thassa's Oracle with no way to empty a library must NOT read 'wins the game' — it should come back UNKNOWN with the missing setup named.

decks.name: Blood Artist — needs a sac loop
decks.note: Aristocrats drains scale on `deaths`, which resolves only when a combo supplies an infinite sacrifice loop — this deck has one (Gravecrawler + a free sac outlet + an Altar), so the five drains should collapse into ONE grouped sentence and read as lethal. Delete Phyrexian Altar and Ashnod's Altar and the same deck must flip to UNKNOWN with the missing loop named.

decks.name: Goblins — combo tokens, no overrun
decks.note: The underclaim canary. Krenko plus untappers makes unbounded goblins with NO otag:overrun card in the deck — this used to score nothing at all and read 'no way to close' while holding a lethal board. Either shape is a pass: when the loop is also a listed win-outright combo the combo row leads and the synthetic token row is suppressed so the same kill isn't counted twice.

decks.name: Bogbeast — unknown scaling
decks.note: Blossoming Bogbeast is '+X/+X where X is the life you gained this turn'. Assuming Craterhoof semantics once scored it at 1091 damage on a real precon; it must report UNKNOWN with the basis quoted.

decks.name: Moraug — extra combats
decks.note: Big red bodies and no overrun effect, so the board alone can't kill anyone through blockers — the second combat step is what converts it. This branch used to score nothing at all and return UNKNOWN, so Aggravated Assault next to a lethal board contributed zero to the verdict.

decks.name: Stax — genuinely no finisher
decks.note: The true negative. A deck that really cannot close should say so — if this ever reads as having a finisher, something is scoring on evidence it shouldn't.
